_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for viewport-test exemptions. Components listed here are internal/utility and never rendered standalone on an operator page -- overflow is handled by the parent that composes them. Edit this file ONCE: both the CI gate (admin-ui/src/test/viewport-checks.js -> EXEMPT_FROM_VIEWPORT_TEST) and the operator Viewport Debt panel (backend/app/viewport_debt.py -> _load_exempt_components) read this file directly, so there is no parallel hand-edited copy to keep in sync. `exempt` is an object mapping component name -> one-line justification (the justification is documentation only; CI uses the keys).

exempt.ErrorBoundary: Internal decorator component for error isolation; not operator-facing.
exempt.MarkdownContent: Pure presentation: renders markdown blocks, used in help/documentation panels where overflow is already handled by parent scroll container.
exempt.ColumnsPicker: Utility component: renders chip columns in KanbanBoard's table; layout controlled entirely by parent, not rendering standalone in operator pages.
exempt.Toasts: Toast notifications: positioned fixed/absolutely, exempt from viewport flow overflow checks; positioned via Tailwind fixed positioning.
exempt.catchupRows: Internal mapper: generates DOM from regression data array; not used standalone on operator pages, used within parent containers that handle layout.
exempt.VersionLifecyclePanel: Sub-panel rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.MessageBubble: Message-row sub-component rendered exclusively inside MessagesPanel; viewport coverage is provided by MessagesPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises the bubble inline (overflow, text-truncation, touch-target).
exempt.CatchUpNeedsAttentionSection: Needs-attention worklist sub-component rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CatchUpRemediationPipelineSection: Remediation-pipeline funnel sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpStatsRow: Headline stats-row sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CatchUpNarrativeSummary: Narrative-summary + trend-pill sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpLatestCycleSection: Latest-strategic-cycle card sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpMemoPathwaySection: Memo-pathway metrics sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpResearchYieldSection: Research-yield funnel sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.CatchUpRecentCompletionsSection: Recent-completions list sub-section rendered exclusively inside CatchUpPanel; viewport coverage is provided by CatchUpPanel.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
exempt.CategoryRow: Per-category trend row rendered exclusively inside SrTrendBreakdown (card and inline variants); viewport coverage is provided by SrTrendBreakdown.viewport.test.tsx.
exempt.SrDiagnosticsStack: SR diagnostics stack rendered exclusively inside DashboardHome; viewport coverage is provided by DashboardHome.viewport.test.tsx which exercises it inline.
